name: Can I build an ADU on a multifamily property?

mainEntity.name: Can I build an ADU on a multifamily property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, multifamily properties can add ADUs equal to a percentage of existing units plus detached units, with specific rules for conversions versus new construction.
